summary: Iteration 31 - Tested new Kirmes-Abrechnungsmodul (Invoice Module). All 23 backend invoice tests passed. Frontend invoice search, display, and action buttons verified. Invoice number auto-increment (R26-K-NNNN), PDF generation, duplicate prevention, and netto/brutto calculation with 19% MwSt all working correctly.
